newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: Advanced Medical Inc said it will redeem all of its outstanding shares of 10 percent cumulative preferred stock on December 16 as part of a settlement agreement with its preferred stockholders.

The redemption price is $10 per share plus $3.72, which represents accrued dividends calculated on a pro rata basis. The redemption price will be payable on or after December 16, upon surrender of the certificates representing the shares of the 10 percent cumulative preferred stock.
